as_told.title: Billy Meier as a Middle East intelligence operative

plain: Before he became known for his UFO claims, a man named Billy Meier was a field intelligence agent in the Middle East, working in places like Tehran and Turkey, and he picked up the name "Billy" in Tehran. That is what the philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels, in two episodes: "The guy was 007. He was a James Bond style super spy field intelligence operative." Jorjani gives no source by name beyond crediting a work called Closer Encounters. The story places this in the 1970s, though Jorjani gives no years in one telling, and if true it would cast Meier's later claims in a very different light.
